title: Model skills config (mpi-model-skills)
description: Attach or detach skills from rules matched against the current model. Later rules win on the same skill name.

enabled.description: false stops applying rules. Default true.

match.description: All present conditions must hold for the rule to apply.

missingInput.description: Every listed modality must be absent from the model's inputs.

hasInput.description: Every listed modality must be present on the model's inputs.

add.description: Skill names (from the discovered pool) or absolute SKILL.md paths ($ENV vars expand; relative paths are rejected).
